GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/foray-no-such-company-xyz123?mode=json
User-Agent: Foray/0.1 (job search agent; local development)

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 41

{"ok":false,"error":"Document not found"}

Notes:
- Unknown account slug => HTTP 404 with a JSON body carrying ok:false.
- Observed identically for slugs netflix, plaid, brex, nubank, getyourguide, cohere
  (i.e. companies that do not use Lever, or whose board is not public).
- An existing account with no public postings returns HTTP 200 with a bare empty
  array: []  (observed for slugs "mistral" and "lever").
- Detect "board does not exist" by status 404 / ok:false, not by an empty array.
